blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to process streaming data, with practitioners relying on benchmarks to select the best model even though these signals only approximate real performance.
While oracle annotations can provide reliable feedback, they are often costly and difficult to obtain at scale.
To address this challenge, we propose Online LLM Picker , the first framework for active model selection for LLMs in online settings. Given an arbitrary stream of queries and a limited annotation budget, Online LLM Picker selects the most informative prompts for annotation to identify the best LLM among candidate models. Across multiple tasks including 10 datasets, for over 130 language models, we show that Online LLM Picker saves annotation cost by up to 71.67 71.67 % while reliably identifying the best or near-best model for the stream.
We also show that using the returned model for sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51 × 2.51\times , indicating that Online LLM Picker can identify the best or near-best model well before processing all streaming prompts.

虽然甲骨文说明可以提供可靠的反馈,但它们往往代价高昂并难以在规模上获得.
为了应对这一挑战,我们提议在线LLM Picker(在线LLM Picker),这是在线环境下LLMs主动模式选择的第一个框架. 鉴于任意的查询流和有限的注解预算,在线LLM Picker选择了信息最丰富的注解提示,以在候选模型中确定最佳LLM. 在包括10个数据集在内的多个任务中,我们显示,对于130多个语言模型来说,在线LLM Picker节省了71.67 71.67%的注解成本,同时可靠地确定了该流的最佳或近最佳模型。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely applied across various domains ( Fan et al., 2023 ; Tan, 2023 ) , from medicine ( Boll et al., 2025 ; Veen et al., 2024 ; Biswas and Talukdar, 2024 ) and industry ( Angelopoulos et al., 2025 ; Kok et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024b ) , to education ( Dan et al., 2023 ; Caines et al., 2023 ) and law ( Pont et al., 2023 ; Lee, 2023 ) , ( Guha et al., 2023 ) .
Alongside this growing adoption, hundreds of publicly available LLMs have emerged ( Google-t5, 2024 ; Meta-Llama, 2024 ; Falcon, 2023 ; DeepSeek, 2025 ; MistralAI, ; Qwen, 2025 ; Nvidia, 2025 ) , many demonstrating strong performance without the need for fine-tuning and the ability to follow instructions and adapt to new tasks with little or no task-specific supervision ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Kojima et al., 2023 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh:
大语言模型(LLMs)广泛应用于各个领域(Fan等,2023;Tan等,2023),从医学(Boll等,2025;Veen等,2024;Biswas和Talukdar,2024)到工业(Angelopoulos等,2025;Kok等,2024;Li等,2024b),从教育(Dan等,2023;Caines等,2023)到法律(Pont等,2023;Lee等,2023)(Guha等,2023)。
除了这种日益增长的采用之外,还出现了数百种公开的有限责任公司(Google-t5, 2024年;Meta-Llama, 2024年;Falcon, 2023年;DeepSeek, 2025年;MistralAI, 2025年;Nvidia, 2025年),其中许多公司表现出强有力的业绩,无需进行微调,也无需在很少或没有具体任务监督的情况下遵循指示和适应新任务的能力(Brown等,2020年;Kojima等,2023年;Dong等,2024年;Liu等,2021年)。

blocks.en: Given the abundance of off-the-shelf models, selecting the most suitable LLM for a particular task or data stream is a non-trivial problem. Existing evaluation pipelines and benchmarks assess performance across diverse datasets and tasks using multiple metrics ( Guo et al., 2023 ) , but no single model consistently excels across domains or datasets ( Chang et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2023 ) . Because LLM effectiveness is highly context-dependent and varies substantially across scenarios, standard evaluation metrics alone cannot fully capture model quality or practical utility ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Kocoń et al., 2023 ) . A common approach to model selection is therefore to rely on randomly or heuristically chosen small subsets of annotated data ( Polo et al., 2024 ; Vivek et al., 2024 ) . However, such strategies often lead to inefficient use of resources and fail to reliably capture differences across models ( Kossen et al., 2021 ) . Active Model Selection ( Madani et al., 2012 ; Karimi et al., 2021 ; Ashury-Tahan et al., 2024 ; Okanovic et al., 2024 ; Kay et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Hara et al., 2024 ; Gardner et al., 2015 ) addresses this limitation by selectively annotating a small set of queries to identify the best model for arbitrary data examples. Yet, prior work has largely focused on classification tasks rather than generation ( Karimi et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Okanovic et al., 2024 ; Kay et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Hara et al., 2024 ) , with the exception of Ashury-Tahan et al. (2024) , which studies language model selection under the assumption that all prompts are available from the outset. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work has explored active model selection for LLMs in online settings to date.
blocks.zh: 鉴于现成模型的丰富性,为特定任务或数据流选择最合适的LLM是一个非三角问题. 现有的评价管道和基准使用多种衡量标准评估不同数据集和任务的业绩(Guo等,2023年),但没有一个单一的模型在域或数据集之间一贯突出(Chan等,2023年;Liang等,2023年)。 由于LLM的有效性高度依赖上下文,而且不同情景之间差异很大,标准评价衡量标准单靠本身无法充分掌握模型质量或实用性(Ouyang等,2022;Kocoń等,2023)。 因此,模型选择的一个共同办法是依靠随机或高压选择的附加说明的数据小子集(Polo等,2024;Vivek等,2024.). 然而,这种战略往往导致资源使用效率低下,无法可靠地反映不同模型之间的差异(Kossen等人,2021年)。 积极模式选择(Madani等,2012年;Karimi等,2021年;Ashury-Tahan等,2024年;Okanovic等,2024年;Kay等,2025年;Liu等,2022年;Li等,2024年a;Hara等,2024年;Gardner等,2015年)解决了这一限制,有选择地指出了一组查询,以确定任意数据实例的最佳模式。 然而,之前的工作主要集中于分类任务而不是生成(Karimi等,2021;Liu等,2022;Okanovic等,2024;Kay等,2025;Li等,2024a;Hara等,2024),但Ashury-Tahan等(2024)除外,后者研究语言模型选择时的假设是,从一开始就有所有的提示. 据我们所知,迄今尚未开展任何工作,探索在线环境中LLM的积极模式选择。

blocks.en:
Contributions : To fill this gap, in this work we propose Online LLM Picker , an active model selection strategy designed to efficiently identify the best candidate LLM in online settings.
Given an incoming stream of prompts and a small annotation budget, Online LLM Picker selects the most informative prompts to annotate in order to reliably identify the best LLM for the stream. Our framework is based on the combined informativeness criterion that maximizes variance across model responses to unannotated prompts while also accounting for posterior uncertainty. Online LLM Picker makes no assumptions about the underlying LLMs, allowing it to be applied to any generative task and any model collection. Online LLM Picker is depicted in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
捐款: 为了填补这一空白,我们在此工作中提议在线LLM Picker(在线LLM Picker),这是一个积极的模型选择策略,旨在高效地确定在线环境中最佳候选人LLM.
鉴于来电的提示和少量的注释预算,Online LLM Picker选择信息最丰富的提示进行注释,以便可靠地确定该流的最佳LLM. 我们的框架以综合信息性标准为基础,该标准将不同模式对无说明提示的反应之间的差异最大化,同时也考虑到后期的不确定性。 在线 LLM Picker不假设基本的LLMs,允许它被应用到任何遗传性任务和任何模型收集. 在线 LLM Picker在图1中作了描述。

blocks.en:
We validate Online LLM Picker through a comprehensive set of experiments spanning multiple LLM generation tasks, including open-ended question answering ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) , open-ended question answering with no correct response ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) , grammar correction of natural language text ( Loem et al., 2023 ) , and both arithmetic ( Gambardella et al., 2024 ) and calculus problems expressed in code-like notation ( Gao et al., 2023 ) . Our model collections across these tasks contain over 130 language models.
We rank the models using both ROUGE ( Lin, 2004 ) and embedding-based similarity measures (e.g. BERTScore ( Zhang et al., 2020 ) ), so that we can capture lexical and semantic agreement with the reference outputs.
Our results demonstrate that Online LLM Picker identifies the best or near-best LLM in online environments while requiring up to 71.67 71.67 % fewer annotations than competing baselines, and reduces regret by up to a factor of 2.51 × 2.51\times when applied to sequential generation on unannotated prompts across the stream.

我们验证在线LLM Picker通过一系列涵盖多个LLM生成任务的综合性实验,包括开放式问题回答(Rajpurkar等,2016年),无正确回答的开放式问题回答(Rajpurkar等,2018年),自然语言文本的语法校正(Loem等,2023年),以及算术(Gambardella等,2024年)和以类似代码注解表达的微积分问题(Gao等,2023年). 我们跨越这些任务的模型集包含130多个语言模型。
我们同时使用ROUGE(Lin,2004年)和嵌入式类似度量衡(例如BERTScore(Zhang等,2020年))对模型进行分级,从而可以捕捉出与参考产出的语法和语义一致.
我们的结果显示,在线LLM Picker确定在线环境中最佳或接近最佳的LLM,同时需要比相竞基线少多达71.67 71.67%的注释,并且在跨行的无附加说明的提示上应用到相继生成时将遗憾减少至2.51× 2.51\分倍.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
A wide range of metrics are proposed for the evaluation of language models , from early automatic metrics such as ROUGE ( Lin, 2004 ) , BLEU ( Papineni et al., 2002 ) , and METEOR ( Lavie and Agarwal, 2007 ) to benchmark-driven progress with GLUE ( Wang et al., 2019 ) , SuperGLUE ( Wang et al., 2020 ) , MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) , and BIG-bench ( Srivastava et al., 2023 ) .
More recently, evaluation has shifted toward human feedback ( Stiennon et al., 2022 ) ; ( Ouyang et al., 2022 ) , but reliance on annotators is costly and limits scalability in large-scale or streaming settings.
LLM-as-a-judge methods ( Gu et al. (2025) ; Bai et al. (2024) ; Chiang et al. (2024) ; Dubois et al. (2025) ) offer more scalable pipelines, though they introduce bias.
Efficiency is also identified as a central concern with Active Testing ( Berrada et al. (2025) ) which reduces annotation cost of evaluation through adaptive sampling. However, such methods focus on evaluating a fixed model or small set of models, whereas our setting requires identifying the best LLM for an arbitrary data stream under limited annotations.
blocks.zh:
为语言模型的评价提出了广泛的衡量标准,从早期的自动衡量标准,如ROUGE(Lin,2004年),BLEU(Papineni等,2002年)和METEOR(Lavie和Agarwal,2007年),到与GLUE(Wang等,2019年),SuperGLUE(Wang等,2020年),MMLU(Hendrycks等,2021年)和BIG-bench(Srivastava等,2023年)的基准驱动进展。
最近,评价已转向人类反馈(Stiennon等人,2022年),(Ouyang等人,2022年),但依赖注释器费用高昂,限制了大规模或流化环境中的可扩展性。
LLM-as-a-judge方法(Gu等 (2025); Bai等 (2024); Chiang等 (2024); Dubois等 (2025)) 提供更可扩展的管道,尽管它们引入了偏差.
效率还被确定为主动测试(Berrada等人(2025年))的中心问题,它通过适应性取样降低了评估的注释成本。 然而,这些方法侧重于评价固定模型或一套小型模型,而我们的设定要求确定有限说明下的任意数据流的最佳LLM。

blocks.en: The most relevant line of work for our setting is active model selection , which seeks to identify the best model from a set of candidates by querying informative examples ( Madani et al., 2012 ; Karimi et al., 2021 ; Ashury-Tahan et al., 2024 ; Okanovic et al., 2024 ; Kay et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Hara et al., 2024 ; Gardner et al., 2015 ) serving as the primary motivation for our work. However, most of these approaches assume a pool-based setup where all queries are available upfront ( Okanovic et al., 2024 ; Ashury-Tahan et al., 2024 ; Kay et al., 2025 ) , or focus on classification tasks ( Karimi et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Okanovic et al., 2024 ; Kay et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024a ; Hara et al., 2024 ) , and are therefore not directly applicable to our setting.
blocks.zh: 我们设定最相关的工作是积极的模型选择,通过查询资料性实例,从一组候选人中找出最佳模型(Madani等,2012年;Karimi等,2021年;Ashury-Tahan等,2024年;Okanovic等,2024年;Kay等,2025年;Liu等,2022年;Li等,2024年a;Hara等,2024年;Gardner等,2015年)。 然而,这些办法大多采用集合式安排,所有查询都可以事先得到(Okanovic等,2024年;Ashury-Tahan等,2024年;Kay等,2025年),或侧重于分类任务(Karimi等,2021年;Liu等,2022年;Okanovic等,2024年;Kay等,2025年;Li等,2024年a;Hara等,2024年),因此不直接适用于我们的设定。

blocks.en: In this work, we introduce the novel problem of online active model selection for large language models and present several strategies as baselines (introduced in Section 4 ) along with ours. We relegate discussions of related but less directly relevant frameworks to Appendix A .

blocks.en:
While time-based decay schedules are common ( Karimi et al., 2021 ) ,
inspired by AdaHedge ( Rooij et al., 2013 ) , we propose an adaptive learning rate η t \eta_{t} that updates based on observed annotations.
In AdaHedge, the dynamic learning rate is defined in terms of the cumulative mixability gap, which measures the cumulative approximation error incurred when approximating the Hedge loss with the mix loss ( Rooij et al., 2013 ) .
By means of Bernstein’s bound, the mixability gap at a certain round t t can be expressed in terms of variance of the losses. In addition, Rooij et al. (2013) shows that the cumulative mixability gap grows at most as the square root of the cumulative loss variance up to t t . Motivated by this, we introduce
an adaptive learning rate that depends on the variance of the losses over the queried examples. The variance of the loss can be computed as: Var i ∼ 𝒑 t ​ ℓ t , i y = ⟨ 𝒑 t , ℓ t y ⊙ ℓ t y ⟩ − ( ⟨ 𝒑 t , ℓ t y ⟩ ) 2 . \underset{i\sim\bm{p}_{t}}{\mathrm{Var}}\,{\ell}_{t,i}^{y}=\langle\bm{p}_{t},\bm{\ell}_{t}^{y}\odot\bm{\ell}_{t}^{y}\rangle-(\langle\bm{p}_{t},\bm{\ell}_{t}^{y}\rangle)^{2}. (4) Although variance-based strategies exist for adapting the learning rate ( Rooij et al., 2013 ) , they are less effective with limited annotations, where sparse queries and a few noisy examples can disproportionately distort the variance estimate. Following the idea of exponential moving averages in optimization ( Kingma and Ba, 2017 ) , which keeps exponential moving averages of the gradient and its square (first and second moments), applies bias correction, and uses them to form a per-parameter adaptive step, we instead introduce an exponential moving average of the variance of the observed examples as a proxy.
This proxy does not track the exact variance of the underlying losses,
but provides a smoothed, adaptive estimate that emphasizes recent
observations while discounting stale ones, thus making the learning rate more robust
under sparse and noisy feedback.

blocks.en:
The query probability q t q_{t} at each time step is designed to capture our uncertainty regarding the identity of the best model on the given prompt x t x_{t} , and subsequently guide our decision of whether to request the annotation of x t x_{t} or not. Importantly, this probability should not only reflect predictive uncertainty but also integrate the current posterior belief over the language models, and balance the competing objectives of exploration and exploitation by doing so. A natural way to operationalize uncertainty in streaming settings is through variance-based measures ( Karimi et al., 2021 ) , which serve as a principled proxy for the potential information gain associated with querying an annotation. Intuitively, the goal is to estimate the expected value of acquiring the annotation for x t x_{t} , that is, the degree to which it would refine our estimate of the best model. More concretely, this quantity can be estimated from the losses incurred by the model responses { f i ​ ( x t ) ∣ i ∈ ℳ } \{f_{i}(x_{t})\mid i\in\mathcal{M}\} , together with the posterior distribution over models 𝒑 t \bm{p}_{t} at time t t . Since the reference annotation y t y_{t} is not available, this variance estimation is hypothetical.
In the classification setting, such a hypothetical variance is well-defined because the true label at time t t is assumed to lie within a finite set of predefined classes.
In contrast, in the generative setting there is no fixed label space: the set of valid responses is open-ended and potentially unbounded, which makes evaluation and comparison
substantially more challenging.
To address this, we approximate the response space at each time t t by considering
the complete set of language model outputs { f i ​ ( x t ) ∣ i ∈ ℳ } \{f_{i}(x_{t})\mid i\in\mathcal{M}\} .

Revisiting the model posterior, which our algorithm updates based on the observed annotations, we find that in some cases it concentrates around a single best model, whereas in others it remains diffuse across multiple candidates.
When the posterior distribution is already concentrated after some annotations, additional annotations have very little impact on the posterior update. Otherwise, a few strategically chosen annotations can shift the balance and determine the best model.
This perspective is rooted in the Bayesian experimental design, where the value of new information is measured by its expected reduction in posterior uncertainty.
Shannon entropy of the posterior provides a natural quantification of ‘how much remains to be learned’ about which model or parameter is best ( Lindley, 1956 ; MacKay, 1992 ; Sebastiani and Wynn, 2025 ) .
A parallel also exists in online decision making: exploration is most valuable when the uncertainty expressed in terms of posterior entropy about the best choice is high, since this is when information can most effectively reduce future regret ( Russo and Roy, 2016 ; Russo and Roy, 2017 ) .

这种观点植根于巴耶斯实验设计,新信息的价值通过它预期的后期不确定性的减少来衡量.
后期的香农任人唯亲地量化了“尚有多少有待学习”的模型或参数最好(Lindley,1956年;MacKay,1992年;Sebastani和Wynn,2025年)。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate Online LLM Picker for active LLM selection in streaming settings using several public generative datasets and model collections containing more than 130 language models. As this is the first study of its kind, we introduce baselines and compare performance across multiple metrics: identification probability , regret , and annotation efficiency for identifying best or near-best models across the stream.
blocks.zh: 我们评价在线LLM Picker在流媒体环境中的活性LLM选择,使用几个公共基因数据集和包含130多语言模型的模型集. 由于这是同类研究的第一项,我们引入了基线,并比较了多种衡量标准的业绩:识别概率、遗憾和说明效率,以便确定整个河流的最佳或近最佳模型。

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和模型

blocks.en:
We benchmark Online LLM Picker against competing baselines across datasets from different generative tasks.
First, we test the algorithms on collections of LLMs for the SQuAD ( Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ) and SQuAD v2 ( Rajpurkar et al., 2018 ) datasets, which are designed for question answering tasks, with the latter including questions that may not have an answer in the given context.
Question answering is often framed as a non-generative task, especially in the extractive setting where models directly copy answer spans from the input text.
In contrast, our models generate answers in their own words, producing open-ended text instead of directly extracting it.
We also use the Comprehensive Arithmetic Problems dataset ( Lee, 2024 ) that features a range of algebraic expressions, the Calculus Datasets (FDU) ( Zhang, 2025 ) that consist of more advanced numerical and symbolic problems represented in LaTeX code, and the Grammar Correction dataset ( Agentlans, 2024 ) , which challenges models to fix grammar mistakes in English sentences. In addition, we also consider MT-Bench ( Bai et al., 2024 ) , a benchmark for evaluating multi-turn conversational ability of LLMs, and multiple datasets from the HELM Benchmark ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . In particular, we include two Longform Question Answering (LF-QA) datasets from classic HELM, LF-QA Canonical and LF-QA Prompt, respectively. From MedHELM ( Bedi et al., 2025 ) we add MedCalc ( Khandekar et al., 2024 ) to our experiments. We also include FinQA ( Chen et al., 2022 ) from HELM Finance.

我们把在线LLM Picker与来自不同基因任务的各种数据集的相竞基线作为基准。
首先,我们为SQuAD(Rajpurkar等,2016年)和SQuAD v2(Rajpurkar等,2018年)数据集测试LLMs集合的算法,这些数据集是为问答任务而设计的,后者包括在特定上下文中可能没有答案的问题.
问答往往被设定为非再生任务,特别是在从输入文本直接复制答案的采掘环境中。
相形之下,我们的模型用他们自己的文字产生答案,产生开放式文本而不是直接取出.
我们还使用具有一系列代数表达功能的"综合算术问题数据集"(Lee, 2024),由LaTeX代码中代表的更高级的数值和符号问题组成的"算术数据集"(FDU, 2025)和"语法校正数据集"(Agentlans, 2024),它们挑战模式来修正英语句子中的语法错误. 此外,我们还认为MT-Bench(Bai等,2024年)是评价LLMs多回合对话能力的基准,也是HELM基准(Liang等,2023年)的多套数据集. 特别是,我们包括了分别取自经典HELM、LF-QA Canonical和LF-QA Super的两个Longform问答数据集。 从MedHELM (Bedi等,2025年) 我们的实验中加入了MedCalc(Khandekar等,2024年). 我们还包括来自HELM Finance的FinQA(Chen等,2022年).

As for the language models, we include several open-source and proprietary LLMs ( Almazrouei et al. (2023) , Radford et al. (2019) , Brown et al. (2020) , Raffel et al. (2023) , OpenAI et al. (2024) , DeepSeek-AI et al. (2025) , Touvron et al. (2023) , Grattafiori et al. (2024) ), ranging from those with a few million parameters to those with several billion. Some of these models are fine-tuned on the specific datasets of interest, while others are general-purpose models suitable for a wide range of generative tasks.
We also expand our model collection to DeepSeek ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025 ) and various GPT-based models ( Brown et al., 2020 ; Kocoń et al., 2023 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ) . An overview of our datasets and models is provided in Table 2 as well as LLM scores on the test datasets in Figure 4 in Appendix B .
To simulate multiple LLMs using the same underlying model, we also apply prompt engineering techniques to instruction-tuned LLMs, encouraging them to behave in agent-specific ways. Prompt engineering is also used to improve performance on our benchmark datasets by reducing unnecessary verbosity and avoiding irrelevant explanations in the output. Our work is model-agnostic and makes no assumptions about LLM architectures or performance. To approximate real-world use, we evaluate across a diverse suite of datasets. More details on LLM collections and datasets can be found in Appendix B .

至于语言模型,我们包括几个开源和专有的LLMs(Almazrouei等 (2023年),Radford等 (2019年),Brown等 (2020年),Raffel等 (2023年),OpenAI等 (2024年),DeepSeek-AI等 (2025年),Touvron等 (2023年),Grattafiori等 (2024年)),从有上百万参数到有上百亿参数. 其中一些模型对感兴趣的特定数据集进行了微调,而另一些模型则是适合广泛基因组任务的通用模型.

blocks.en: 4.2 Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 基线

blocks.en:
We introduce several strategies and baselines and evaluate the performance of Online LLM Picker against them.
These methods typically follow a coin-flipping strategy. At each time instance t t , when a new prompt x t x_{t} is received, the decision to query the reference annotation y t y_{t} is made by sampling a Bernoulli random variable Q t Q_{t} with bias q t q_{t} , which is usually adaptive. The reference annotation y t y_{t} is queried only if Q t = 1 Q_{t}=1 .

我们推出了若干战略和基线,并对照这些战略和基线评估在线LLM Picker的业绩。
这些方法一般遵循出钱策略. 在每次 t t 实例中, 当收到新的 proogle x t x_{t} 时, 查询参考注释 y t y_{t} 的决定是通过取样 Bernoulli 随机变量 Q t t} 带有偏差 q t q_{t} , 这通常是适应性的 。 只有在Q t = 1 Q_{t}=1 时,才会对引用注释 y y_{t 进行查询。

blocks.en:
For Random (passive learning) baseline, we query annotation of each time instance with a fixed probability q t = b / T q_{t}=b/T , having an expected number of b b annotations queried over a stream of length T T . For Disagreement baseline, we only consider prompts where the language models strongly disagree and use a fixed q t = b / T q_{t}=b/T on those instances. Disagreement is quantified as the variance across experts in their average pairwise discrepancies, and a query is triggered when this measure exceeds a small threshold we introduced. We adapt the Kullback–Leibler baseline where KL queries with probability proportional to the Kullback–Leibler divergence ( Shlens, 2014 ) between distribution of pairwise losses at time instance t t and the posterior belief, to encourage annotations when the loss distribution deviates strongly from the learned belief. We adapt Uncertainty ( Dagan and Engelson, 1995 ) to our setting to query annotations with probability similar to the Shannon entropy of the pairwise losses over candidate models.
It estimates how evenly the models support competing hypotheses and regards higher entropy as greater uncertainty.

关于随机(被动学习)基线,我们以固定概率 q t = b / T q_{t}=b/ T 查询每个时间实例的注释,在T T 的一行长度中询问预期的b个注释。 对于分歧的基线,我们只考虑语言模型强烈异议的提示,并在这些例子中使用固定的q t = b / T q_{t}=b/T . 分歧被量化为专家之间平均对等差异的差异,当这一措施超过我们提出的一个小阈值时,就会引发询问。 我们调整了 KUL – Leibler 基线, KL 询问的概率与 KUL BUL – Leibler 的概率成正比(Shlens, 2014 ) , 在时间t 的双向损失分配和后向信仰之间, 当损失分配强烈偏离所学信仰时鼓励说明。 我们将不确定因素(Dagan和Engelson, 1995年)适应我们的设置, 以类似双向损耗的香农的概率,
它估计模型如何均衡地支持相竞的假说,并将更高的py视为更大的不确定性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate Online LLM Picker separately on each dataset. For a given dataset, we generate a stream by drawing T T i.i.d. instances uniformly at random and feeding them to each method, referring to each such stream as a realization . For each realization, we evaluate performance based on the language model returned by each method. We repeat this process over multiple independent realizations with fresh streams drawn from the test set, and average the results to estimate the expected performance for each metric.
blocks.zh: 我们分别评估每个数据集的在线LLM Picker。 对于一个给定的数据集,我们通过随机统一地绘制 T T i. d. 实例来生成一个流,并将其输入到每种方法中,将每个流称为实现 。 对于每一个实现,我们根据每种方法返回的语言模型来评价性能. 我们通过多个独立实现来重复这一进程,从测试集中抽取出新鲜的流程,并平均得出结果,以估计每个度量的预期业绩。

blocks.en: We define the budget b b as the maximum number of annotations that a method can query within a given realization. We evaluate the methods across different budget levels. For a fair comparison under the same budget, we tune the hyperparameter(s) of each method to query the same number of annotations on average at the end of the stream and compare their performance. Hyperparameter tuning adjusts the query probability of a method by multiplying it with different up- or down-scaling factors to control how many annotations each method ends up requesting on average across all realizations.
blocks.zh: 我们把预算bb定义为一种方法可以在给定的实现中查询的注释的最大数量. 我们评估不同预算水平的方法。 为了在同一预算下进行公平比较,我们调和每种方法的超参数,以便平均在流尾查询相同数目的说明并比较其性能。 超参数调制调整了一种方法的查询概率,方法是用不同的上下缩放系数来相乘,以控制每种方法平均要求在所有实现中有多少个注释.

blocks.en: 4.4 Performance Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.4 性能计量

blocks.en:
We evaluate each algorithm using the following metrics.
First, for a fixed annotation budget, we compute the regret to measure how well the models returned by each method perform in sequential generation on the unannotated prompts across the stream. Second, we measure identification probability , defined as the fraction of realizations in which the best model is correctly identified by the end of the stream. Finally, we assess annotation efficiency , which captures how efficiently a method identifies the best or near-best language models relative to the number of annotations used.
blocks.zh:
我们用以下的尺度来评估每个算法.
首先,对于一个固定的注解预算,我们计算出一种遗憾,以衡量每种方法返回的模型在无附加说明的提示下连续生成时的表现。 其次,我们测量识别概率 , 定义为在流尾正确识别出最佳模型的实现分数. 最后,我们评估注解效率,它反映了一种方法相对于所使用注解的数量如何有效地确定最佳或接近最佳的语言模型。

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Regret

For a given budget where Online LLM Picker returns a model with high confidence, we report the expected regret averaged over all realizations.
Our experiments are robust to the choice of budget and we evaluate Online LLM Picker and baselines at very different budget levels.
In all cases, Online LLM Picker consistently achieves a reduction in regret, in some cases reaching up to a factor of 2.51 × 2.51\times with respect to the best competing baseline, which shows its ability for sequential generation even well before exhausting its annotation budget. Details on annotation budget levels and further results are reported in Table 3 of Appendix D .

在所有情况下,在线LLM Picker始终在减少遗憾,在某些情况下,在最佳竞争基准方面达到2.51×2.51\的系数,这表明它有能力在用尽注释预算之前连续生成。 附录D表3详细报告了说明预算水平和进一步结果。

blocks.en: 5 Discussions
blocks.zh: 5 讨论

blocks.en: We introduce the novel problem of online model selection for language models with limited annotation evidence, which is a technically challenging setting given the open-ended nature of generative outputs. We propose Online LLM Picker , a method tailored to this task that confidently identifies the best language model for the task in an annotation-efficient manner. As LLMs are increasingly deployed in domains where annotation budgets are limited and data distributions shift, Online LLM Picker enables adaptive model selection that reduces annotation costs, maintains performance under evolving conditions, and improves the robustness of real-world LLM deployment.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个新问题,即在线选择语言模型的模型,但注释证据有限,鉴于基因产出的开放式,这是一个技术上具有挑战性的设置。 我们提议在线LLM Picker, 一种适合这项任务的方法, 由于LLMs越来越多地被部署在注释预算有限和数据分布变化的领域中,在线LLM Picker使得适应性模型选择能够降低注释成本,在不断变化的条件下保持性能,并改进现实世界LLM部署的稳健性.

(2025) uses variable sequence length and batch-size to improve long-context modeling. Wang et al. (2025) applies a similar approach for in-context learning.
Other studies draw on importance or loss-based sampling , where training examples are weighted by estimated contribution to learning progress.
At large scale, related ideas appear in corpus-level mixture design, such as the fixed data-mixture weights used to balance sources in GPT-3 ( Brown et al., 2020 ) , which adjust the proportions of different domains to achieve a desired training distribution.
Some methods address corpus in a heterogeneous way through balanced or cluster-based selection, which preserves diversity by balancing common and rare examples to improve model training (
            , 
          ) .
Recently, Shao et al. (2024) introduces distribution-level curriculum learning for LLM post-training, dynamically balancing exploration and exploitation across reward-conditioned datasets.
While these approaches significantly reduce training cost or improve data efficiency, they generally assume offline access to the full corpus or slowly changing data distributions.
They thus differ from our setting, which requires adaptive decisions on streaming data with a limited annotation budget.

blocks.en: When evaluating generative language models, a wide range of metrics can be used. Traditional approaches rely on statistical measures such as BLEU and ROUGE, while more recent methods include sentence-embedding–based metrics and even LLM-as-a-judge evaluations. However, these metrics can become unreliable when the data comes from highly specialized domains. In such cases, general-purpose embedding models or LLM-based judges may fail to capture true semantic similarity, resulting in noisy or misleading scores. In practice, the choice of an appropriate metric is highly context-dependent and closely tied to the underlying data distribution. For example, in our experiments with medical datasets, several open source embedding models produced nearly constant similarity scores across sentences, effectively reducing the algorithms’ behavior to randomness. Identifying robust, domain-appropriate evaluation metrics is an active area of research for many generative tasks, but a detailed investigation of this topic lies beyond the scope of our current work.
blocks.zh: 在评价基因语言模型时,可以使用广泛的度量衡. 传统方法依赖诸如BLEU和ROUGE等统计措施,而更近期的方法包括基于句子的衡量标准,甚至LLM-as-a-judge的评价。 然而,当数据来自高度专业化的领域时,这些衡量标准可能变得不可靠。 在这种情况下,通用嵌入模型或基于LLM的评委可能无法捕捉出真实的语义相似性,从而导致噪音或误导分数. 在实践中,选择适当的衡量标准高度取决于背景,并与基本数据分布密切相关。 例如,在我们使用医学数据集的实验中,几个开源嵌入模型在句子之间产生了近乎恒常的相似性分数,有效地将算法的行为降到了随机. 确定强有力的、适合领域的评价衡量标准是许多遗传性任务的一个积极研究领域,但对这一专题的详细调查超出了我们当前工作的范围。

blocks.en: F.1 Rationale for Metric Selection
blocks.zh: F.1 计量选择的理由

blocks.en: While more recent evaluation frameworks increasingly utilize Large Language Model (LLM) based metrics due to their higher correlation with human judgment, we intentionally select ROUGE and BERTScore for our evaluation pipeline. This decision is driven by three primary factors: stability, reproducibility, and computational feasibility.
blocks.zh: 虽然较近期的评价框架由于与人类判断的更紧密关联,越来越多地使用基于大语言模型的衡量标准,但我们有意选择ROUGE和BERTScore作为评价程序。 这一决定由三个主要因素驱动:稳定性、可复制性和计算可行性。

blocks.en: First, standard metrics like ROUGE and BERTScore offer a level of stability and simplicity that remains foundational in generative model evaluation. In contrast, LLM-based evaluators, despite their sophistication, are often susceptible to significant variability, sensitivity to specific prompt phrasing, and inherent model biases. Our preliminary experiments with sentence-embedding-based similarity metrics revealed them to be considerably noisier and less stable across streaming batches. Specifically, we observed that embedding scores tended to cluster tightly with minimal spread, even when model outputs were meaningfully different. This suggests that such models may fail to reliably distinguish between genuinely similar and dissimilar responses in our specific context.
blocks.zh: 首先,ROUGE和BERTScore等标准衡量标准提供了一定的稳定性和简便性,在基因模型评价中仍然具有基础性. 相比之下,基于LLM的评价人员尽管很复杂,但往往容易出现很大的可变性、对特定即时措辞的敏感性以及固有的模型偏差。 我们有关基于句子的类似性衡量标准的初步实验表明,这些指数在流出各批次中具有相当的噪声并不太稳定。 具体地说,我们注意到,即使模型产出存在有意义的差异,嵌入得分往往以最小的差幅紧密地组合起来。 这表明,这种模式可能无法可靠地区分真正相似和不同的反应。

blocks.en: Second, the computational and financial overhead associated with LLM-based evaluators is substantial. Given that our methodology requires calculating pairwise distances across a large collection of language models ( m = 54 m=54 ), the quadratic nature of these comparisons makes LLM-based scoring impractical for large-scale or online evaluation.
blocks.zh: 第二,与基于LLM的评价员有关的计算和财务间接费用数额很大。 鉴于我们的方法需要计算出跨越大量语言模型(m = 54 m = 54)的双相距离,这些比较的四相性使得基于LLM的分数对于大规模或在线评价是不切实际的.

blocks.en: Finally, by utilizing established metrics, we ensure that our results are easily reproducible without requiring access to proprietary or high-cost APIs. While we recognize that evaluating our framework under advanced LLM-based metrics is a valuable direction for future research, the current selection provides a robust and efficient baseline for measuring model performance and hypothetical variance.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们通过使用既定的衡量标准,确保我们的成果易于复制,而不需要获得专有或高成本的API。 虽然我们认识到,根据基于LLM的先进衡量标准评估我们的框架是未来研究的宝贵方向,但目前的选择为衡量模型绩效和假设差异提供了一个有力而有效的基准。

blocks.en: F.2 Computational Overhead Analysis
blocks.zh: F.2 计算间接费用分析

blocks.en: In practice, this overhead is negligible. By preprocessing the dataset to compute all pairwise similarities before running the experiments, we significantly improve efficiency.
